```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
library(kyotil)
library(glue)
load("R/forRmd.RData")   # load the objects from a file
load("R/cell_dat.RData") # load the objects from a file
key.markers <- c("CD15", "CD3", "CD11c", "CD123", "CD56", "CD68")
tissue_size_2 <- read.csv(paste0(data.dir, "/tissue_size_by_depth_and_region_2.csv"))
tissue_size_2$biopsy <- get.slide.name(tissue_size_2$biopsy)
```

## Analysis 1: Each region as a separate observation

Treat each intact/ulcer region individually using region-level size data.

Pearson correlation coefficients are computed on the antilog scale. 

LG1_Les is skipped to avoid coding error because there is no epithelial lesion in that slide.

```{r per-region-compute, include=FALSE}
cor.summary.1 <- data.frame(marker = key.markers, r = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, r_density = NA_real_, p_density = NA_real_)
results.1 <- list()

for (a in key.markers) {

  all.res <- NULL
  for (biopsy in biopsies) {

    slides <- slides.by.biopsy[[biopsy]]
    slides <- slides[slides != "LG1_Les"]

    res <- lapply(slides, function(s) {

      # myprint(s)

      if (!is.null(cell_dat[[s]][[a]])) {

        size.ulcer.epi <- subset(tissue_size_2, biopsy == s & region == 'ulcerative' & dist_type == 'dist2DEJ' & depth < 0)

        if (nrow(size.ulcer.epi) > 0) {
          size.ulcer.epi <- aggregate(area ~ region_id, size.ulcer.epi, sum)

          cell.ulcer.epi <- subset(cell_dat[[s]][[a]], region == 'ulcerative' & epi)

          sapply(1:nrow(size.ulcer.epi), function(i) {
            region_id <- size.ulcer.epi[i, "region_id"]
            col_id <- grep(glue("epi_region_{region_id}_lesion"), colnames(cell.ulcer.epi))
            c(cell_count = sum(cell.ulcer.epi[[col_id]] == "True"), size = size.ulcer.epi[i, "area"])
          })
        }

      }

    })
    res <- res[sapply(res, function(x) !is.null(x))]

    if (len(res) > 0) {
      tmp <- do.call(cbind, res)
      colnames(tmp) <- names(res) %.% (1:ncol(tmp))
      all.res <- rbind(all.res, t(tmp))
    }
  }

  all.res <- cbind(all.res, density = all.res[, 'cell_count'] / all.res[, 'size'])
  ct <- cor.test(all.res[, 'cell_count'], all.res[, 'size'], method = "pearson")
  ct_density <- cor.test(all.res[, 'density'], all.res[, 'size'], method = "pearson")
  cor.summary.1[cor.summary.1$marker == a, 'r']         <- as.numeric(ct$estimate)
  cor.summary.1[cor.summary.1$marker == a, 'p']         <- as.numeric(ct$p.value)
  cor.summary.1[cor.summary.1$marker == a, 'r_density'] <- as.numeric(ct_density$estimate)
  cor.summary.1[cor.summary.1$marker == a, 'p_density'] <- as.numeric(ct_density$p.value)
  results.1[[a]] <- all.res
}
```

```{r per-region-render, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
for (a in key.markers) {
  all.res <- results.1[[a]]
  child_out <- knitr::knit_child(text = c(
    "```{=latex}",
    "\\clearpage",
    "```",
    "",
    paste("###", a),
    "",
    paste0('```{r per-region-', a, ', echo=FALSE, results="asis", fig.width=10, fig.height=5, fig.pos="H", fig.align="center"}'),
    'all.res.fmt <- as.data.frame(all.res)',
    'all.res.fmt$size    <- formatDouble(all.res.fmt$size,    digits = 1)',
    'all.res.fmt$density <- formatDouble(all.res.fmt$density, digits = 1)',
    'print(knitr::kable(all.res.fmt, caption = paste(a, "- per region"), booktabs = TRUE, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")) |>',
    '  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position"))',
    'par(mfrow = c(1, 2)); reduce_margin()',
    'corplot(cell_count ~ size, all.res, add.diagonal.line = FALSE, log = "xy")',
    'corplot(density ~ size, all.res, add.diagonal.line = FALSE, log = "")',
    '```'
  ), envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE)
  cat(child_out, sep = '\n')
}
```

```{r cor-summary-1}
cor.summary.1$p         <- formatPvalues(as.numeric(cor.summary.1$p),         p.digits = 3)
cor.summary.1$r         <- formatDouble(as.numeric(cor.summary.1$r),         digits = 2)

cor.summary.1$r_density <- formatDouble(as.numeric(cor.summary.1$r_density), digits = 2)
knitr::kable(cor.summary.1, col.names = c("Marker", "Pearson cor", "p-value", "Pearson cor", "p-value"), booktabs = TRUE, align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c")) |>
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "count vs size" = 2, "density vs size" = 2))
```

## Analysis 2: Combined regions per slide

Combine intact/ulcer epithelial regions within each slide, treating each ulcer as independent (ignoring ptid/slide/ulcer structure).

```{r combined-regions-compute, include=FALSE}
cor.summary.2 <- data.frame(marker = key.markers, r = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, r_density = NA_real_, p_density = NA_real_)
results.2 <- list()

for (a in key.markers) {

  all.res <- NULL
  for (biopsy in biopsies) {

    slides <- slides.by.biopsy[[biopsy]]
    slides <- slides[slides != "LG1_Les"]

    res <- mysapply(slides, function(s) {

      if (!is.null(cell_dat[[s]][[a]])) {

        size.ulcer.epi <- sum(subset(tissue_size, biopsy == s & region == 'ulcerative' & dist_type == 'dist2DEJ' & depth < 0)$area)

        cell.ulcer.epi <- nrow(subset(cell_dat[[s]][[a]], region == 'ulcerative' & epi))

        c(cell_count = cell.ulcer.epi, size = size.ulcer.epi)

      } else {
        c(0, 0)
      }

    })

    all.res <- rbind(all.res, res)
  }

  all.res <- all.res[all.res[, 'size'] > 0, ]
  all.res <- cbind(all.res, density = all.res[, 'cell_count'] / all.res[, 'size'])
  ct <- cor.test(all.res[, 'cell_count'], all.res[, 'size'], method = "pearson")
  ct_density <- cor.test(all.res[, 'density'], all.res[, 'size'], method = "pearson")
  cor.summary.2[cor.summary.2$marker == a, 'r']         <- as.numeric(ct$estimate)
  cor.summary.2[cor.summary.2$marker == a, 'p']         <- as.numeric(ct$p.value)
  cor.summary.2[cor.summary.2$marker == a, 'r_density'] <- as.numeric(ct_density$estimate)
  cor.summary.2[cor.summary.2$marker == a, 'p_density'] <- as.numeric(ct_density$p.value)
  results.2[[a]] <- all.res
}
```

```{r combined-regions-render, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
for (a in key.markers) {
  all.res <- results.2[[a]]
  child_out <- knitr::knit_child(text = c(
    "```{=latex}",
    "\\clearpage",
    "```",
    "",
    paste("###", a),
    "",
    paste0('```{r combined-regions-', a, ', echo=FALSE, results="asis", fig.width=10, fig.height=5, fig.pos="H", fig.align="center"}'),
    'all.res.fmt <- as.data.frame(all.res)',
    'all.res.fmt$size    <- formatDouble(all.res.fmt$size,    digits = 1)',
    'all.res.fmt$density <- formatDouble(all.res.fmt$density, digits = 1)',
    'print(knitr::kable(all.res.fmt, caption = paste(a, "- combined regions"), booktabs = TRUE, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")) |>',
    '  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "HOLD_position"))',
    'par(mfrow = c(1, 2)); reduce_margin()',
    'corplot(cell_count ~ size, all.res, add.diagonal.line = FALSE, log = "xy")',
    'corplot(density ~ size, all.res, add.diagonal.line = FALSE, log = "")',
    '```'
  ), envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE)
  cat(child_out, sep = '\n')
}
```

```{r barplot-r-2, fig.width=5, fig.height=8}
marker.order <- c("CD68", "CD56", "CD3", "CD123", "CD11c", "CD15")
cor.summary.2 <- cor.summary.2[match(marker.order, cor.summary.2$marker), ]
rownames(cor.summary.2) <- NULL
par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(4, 6, 2, 1))
cols <- "gray"
names.count   <- paste0(cor.summary.2$marker, "\n(p=", formatPvalues(as.numeric(cor.summary.2$p),         p.digits = 3), ")")
names.density <- paste0(cor.summary.2$marker, "\n(p=", formatPvalues(as.numeric(cor.summary.2$p_density), p.digits = 3), ")")
barplot(as.numeric(cor.summary.2$r), names.arg = names.count, horiz = TRUE,
        las = 1, xlab = "Pearson cor", main = "count vs size",
        col = cols, space = 1.5, width = 0.35, xlim = c(-1, 1))
barplot(as.numeric(cor.summary.2$r_density), names.arg = names.density, horiz = TRUE,
        las = 1, xlab = "Pearson cor", main = "density vs size",
        col = cols, space = 1.5, width = 0.35, xlim = c(-1, 1))
